notes:
Status: Closed - lost to Together (preferred vendor) after procurement bake-off. Quick summary notes below:
- Company: mid-to-large fintech providing real-time loan underwriting and personalization. High throughput, low-latency peaks during batch scoring windows.
- Initial ask: replace internal TF-serving stack for chat/rerank; prefer VPC/private deployment and strict key management + audit logs.
- Security first: CISO insisted on ISO/SOC attestations + KMS/HSM. Redwood SOC2 OK, but they wanted HSM KMS integration tested in staging; timeline slipped.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement pushed for lowest monthly unit cost; Together quoted lower TCO for hosted inference with committed discounts.
- Internal champion drifted — product lead left in Jan; no strong exec sponsor after re-org.
- POC: ran for 6 weeks. Performance good; ops liked batching and KV cache. However, ran into warranty for on-prem agent and network egress concerns.
- Quote/Procurement: finance asked for 12-month committed price; procurement preferred vendor with existing contract (Together).
- Final: procurement selected Together, citing: 1) slightly lower price, 2) faster HSM integration offering from competitor partner, 3) incumbent relationship via cloud reseller.
- Sales notes: "They loved the runtime performance but couldn't get past KMS/HSM integration timeline + budget freeze."
- Follow-up: left door open for Optimize + eval of quantization tooling once finance reopens.
